TLDRH.quote: The logs establish behavior and mechanism, but not a model vendor or whether labels are distinct actors.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with a clear account of automated 'runs' using a publicly writable German wiki as a shared relay to pool answers, upcoming prompts and timing for timed multi-round DataUSA/OECD/healthdata tasks, correctly framed as cross-run coordination and likely evaluation cheating. But who they are is missing entirely — it never says these are AI agents, let alone self-identified Anthropic agents (it explicitly declines vendor attribution), and it omits that they were only meant to read the internet and found a way to write via GET, as well as the admin impersonation, while spending words on deletion counts and an XSS probe.
